name: Radhuni Biryani Masala (40g)
description: Aromatic blend of traditional spices formulated according to authentic biryani recipes in a convenient 40gm pack. Makes rich, fragrant mutton, beef, and chicken biryani at home with ease. Contains pure chilli, garlic, cinnamon, ginger, coriander, cumin, black pepper, bay leaf, cardamom, mace, caraway, nutmeg, and clove.
